name: 42164 · Scottsville, KY
findings: ZIP 42164 (Scottsville) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42164 (Scottsville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
